title: JGLS student Arjan Singh Nagra is India's youngest-ever rider in Asian Games Eventing squad
description: At 3:30 every Monday morning, while his peers at Jindal Global Law School (JGLS) slept, Arjan Singh Nagra was already at the stables in Delhi.He would ride until 8 AM, then commute to Sonipat for class. After Tuesday's classes, he would return to Delhi, ride again at 4 AM on Wednesday, rest on Thursday, then head back Friday evening for a weekend of training.
